What other students can see

  • Friends you've accepted can see the classes and sections on your schedule — that is what the Quad and Groups are built on.
  • Nobody else can. Your schedule is not public and is not shown to students you haven't added.
  • Reviews you post are anonymous. Your name is never attached to a review anywhere in the app.
  • Your past classes and grades are yours alone. Grades are used only in aggregate and are never tied to you.

Delete account

Removes your profile, classes, sections, past classes, friends and reviews. Permanent — there is no undo and no export.

About Professify

Real Cal Poly professors and confirmed Fall 2026 instructors, with ratings synced live from PolyRatings' open API, and seat, waitlist, and meeting-time data scraped daily from Cal Poly Class Search. Pick your major and Professify shows who's teaching each required course, how they're rated, and how full each section is — so you can plan the term around the right professors.
Professor ratings are pulled live from PolyRatings' public API (github.com/Polyratings/polyratings), on a 0–4 scale. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cal Poly, RateMyProfessors, or PolyRatings.
